title: What Do I Know About You
summary: Johnny makes four claims about V at a Heywood bar, one of them false, and V has to say which.
description: Johnny wants to play a game about V. At a Heywood bar, he will make four claims about V, and one of them is false.

start.bringUp: Johnny wants to play a game about you. Bring up, in your own way and smug, that V should sit at a bar in Heywood and order a drink, because he will tell four things about V and one is a lie.

bar.name: a bar in Heywood on the Wellsprings side

g1.asks: So? Which one's the lie? And tell me what you wish I didn't know.
g1.know: Johnny has made four claims about V from live reads of the gear, the hour and the district, and one is false. The game marks V's pick right or wrong. A nightlife stranger sits nearby.
g1.secret: He borrows V's memories more than he lets on.
g1.wants: V to commit to a claim and be a little honest.

stages.label: Name the lie among Johnny's four claims
stages.objective: Name the lie among Johnny's four claims at the Heywood bar
stages.know: V is at a Heywood bar with a drink. Johnny makes four claims about V, built from live reads, and one of them is false. A stranger at the next stool starts talking to V.
stages.wants: V to pick which of the four claims is the lie.

do.who: a nightlife stranger at the bar

right.memory: You named the lie in Johnny's four claims about you, and he gave you a rare compliment.

wrong.memory: You picked the wrong claim in Johnny's game, and he gloated about it.

variations.know: The four claims are about the day's route.
The four claims are about the car V is driving.
The four claims are about recent kills, with no counts.
